news.title: Trump vows Iran will be 'living in Hell' by Tuesday if Strait of Hormuz deadline missed
news.description: "Tuesday will be Power Plant Day, and Bridge Day, all wrapped up in one, in Iran. There will be nothing like it!!!" Trump said in a Truth Social post.

news.title: Chinese chip firms hit record high revenue driven by the AI boom and U.S. curbs
news.description: Chinese chip companies have benefited from strong domestic demand for AI as U.S. tech curbs have bolstered local firms.

news.title: 'Anything but autos': Can defense save Europe’s ailing car industry?
news.description: The transition from wheels to weapons is achievable in part because many of the underlying skills are highly transferable, according to experts.
